title: Understanding Meiosis I
text: Remember that meiosis I is a reduction division. One diploid cell (2n) divides to produce two haploid cells (n). This halves the chromosome number.

title: Understanding Meiosis II
text: Meiosis II is similar to mitosis. Each of the two cells from meiosis I divides again. So 2 cells become 4 cells, all haploid (n=23 in humans).
